children: A total of nearly 100 companies, including those part of the benchmark Nifty 50 index and the broader markets, will be reporting their results for the September quarter during the course of this week, which also happens to be a truncated one. Bajaj Finance, UltraTech, Infosys, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IDFC First Bank, Swiggy, Eternal, among many other important names report results during the week.

No results will be declared on Tuesday, as it will be a stock market holiday on account of Dusshera. The 90-odd results will be spread across Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday as well, when the likes of Kotak Mahindra Bank and IDFC First Bank report numbers. Here's a look at the results list in greater detail.

Bajaj Finance, Delta Corp, Gallant Ispat, GOCL Corporation, HFCL, Hindustan Zinc, IREDA, Just Dial, LTTS, NELCO, Piramal Finance, SML Mahindra, Sobha, Tatva Chintan Pharma, UltraTech, Union Bank, Varmora Granito, Waaree Renewable Tech.
